row.evidence: Lucid's SCIM overview says 'Plan availability: Enterprise only', and the pricing page lists Enterprise as Contact sales with SAML authentication; Team is $10/user per month billed annually.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Team price rose from $9 to $10/user/mo billed annually. June's '~$199/u/yr list' Enterprise figure has no first-party source and is dropped; Enterprise is Contact sales. SCIM 2.0 at https://users.lucid.app/scim/v2 with bearer tokens from two separate apps (SCIM for admin management = org groups and licensing; SCIM for content access = teams). Deactivate = active:false (user cannot log in); DELETE is a hard delete. Okta and Entra gallery apps are first-class; other IdPs use the generic API. Google Workspace provisioning is a Lucid-run sync, Enterprise only. REST API (api.lucid.co) lists users and manages licenses and teams; user creation via REST is Enterprise only; audit-log API needs Enterprise Shield.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit-log API requires the Enterprise Shield add-on.

auth.token_source: Admin > App integration > SCIM for admin management (or SCIM for content access); auto-upgrade licensing must be enabled to generate a token

deprovision.data_retained: active:false keeps the account but the user cannot log in; DELETE is a hard delete (account owners and default document owners cannot be deleted). Removing a user from a licensing org group delicenses them and frees the license.

pagination.notes: startIndex/count parameters; filtered requests return at most 10,000 users.

roles.how: SCIM roles attribute with administrative role values (AccountAdmin, BillingAdmin, Developer, DocumentAdmin, EnterpriseShieldAdmin, TemplateAdmin); licenses via org-group push.

limitations.text: Two SCIM apps (admin management and content access) both provision users; a leaver must be removed from both.
Filtering supports only the eq operator and returns at most 10,000 users.
Only Okta and Entra ID have supported apps; other IdPs must call the SCIM API directly.

user_api.notes: Plan inferred from 'Developer platform' listed under Team on the pricing page; Create User is Enterprise only.

google.notes: Lucidchart Google Marketplace app plus Lucid-run Google Workspace sync (Enterprise only); Google sign-in is OAuth, not SAML.

onelogin.notes: No Lucid guide for OneLogin; Lucid says other IdPs use the SCIM API directly.

jumpcloud.notes: No Lucid guide for JumpCloud; Lucid says other IdPs use the SCIM API directly.
